_about: The ad-to-site data (SITE-GOALS §4): hooks and page variants, so a new ad needs no code change. ?h=<id> puts the ad's first line in the headline slot (home and /breathe) and preselects its session on /breathe; unknown ids are ignored. line_en: the headline (7 words or fewer). sub_en: the one line under it ({guide} is the session's narrator). world: the colour world the ad ends in (the /breathe first frame). card_en, edge_sub_en, start_f: /breathe variant f only. Swedish lines (line_sv) not written yet. variants: what ?v= may pick on each page; anything else falls back to the default.  g_sub_en: the line under the headline in variant g for this hook (default: '<choice> with <guide> · 6 min · free'). g_edge: the crisper, faster arrival (the challenger).

coffee.sub_en: Try 6 minutes of breathing with {guide} instead. Free, no app needed.

email.sub_en: 6 minutes of breathing with {guide} first. Free, no app needed.

keepup.g_sub_en:
Faster rounds · breath of fire
with {guide} · 6 min · free

night.sub_en: 6 slow minutes with {guide}. Fine to do lying down. Free.

variants._about: ?v= picks a page variant for the A/B. Every event carries the variant actually shown (v).

options.hero-still: the brand-film still (eyes closed): a right-hand panel on desktop, a top band on phones (default; Isak decides later)
options.hero-landscape: a landscape instead (forest at dawn), no person

options.g1: g: one line, the sphere, Begin; swipe between the worlds (live since 29 Sep); ?v=g is the same
